# Agent Python Tools

## File: facebookresearch_digit360/digit360/interface/system/digit360_programmer.py

Prompts

```
['run the digit360 programmer CLI to flash firmware to a device using a binary file', 'run the main function to connect to a digit360 device and flash new firmware', 'run the firmware_update function to flash a binary file to the digit360 device via dfu-util', 'run the check_dfu_util_version function to verify dfu-util is installed and meets the minimum version', 'run the is_device_dfu_ready function to check if a USB device is in DFU mode']
```

Usage

```
{'run_firmware_update_cli': 'run the digit360 programmer CLI to flash firmware to a device using a binary file', 'run_main_firmware_flash': 'run the main function to connect to a digit360 device and flash new firmware', 'run_firmware_update': 'run the firmware_update function to flash a binary file to the digit360 device via dfu-util', 'run_check_dfu_util_version': 'run the check_dfu_util_version function to verify dfu-util is installed and meets the minimum version', 'run_is_device_dfu_ready': 'run the is_device_dfu_ready function to check if a USB device is in DFU mode'}
```
